1859.name: Climbing The Mountain

up.description: To the up lies Climbing The Mountain.

down.description: To the down lies The Rangers Camp.

1859.description:
The lower slopes of the mountain are clothed in birch and rowan, their
pale trunks leaning on a hillside littered with mossy boulders. A rough
path switches back and forth across the slope, climbing toward darker
pines and bare grey rock above. Below, between the trees, the Rangers
Camp lies close at hand among the birches. The air is cool and smells of
earth and fallen leaves.

1860.name: Climbing The Mountain

up.description: To the up lies At The Cave.

down.description: To the down lies The Rangers Camp.

1860.description:
The path climbs steeply here through twisted pines that grip the rock
with bare, knotted roots. Above, the trees give out against a face of
grey stone, and a dark cave mouth gapes just a short scramble up the
slope. The air is thin and sharp with resin, and loose scree slithers
away underfoot at every step. Far below, through the branches, a thread
of woodsmoke rises from the Rangers Camp, where the path leads back
down.

1861.name: At The Cave

south.description: To the south lies The Cave-In.

down.description: To the down lies Climbing The Mountain.

1861.description:
Just inside the mouth of a cave high on the mountain, the rock walls
arch close overhead, blackened by the soot of old campfires. Daylight
spills in from the opening behind you, where a steep path drops back
down the wooded slope. A chill draught breathes out of the dark to the
south, carrying the smell of wet stone and the faint grind of shifting
rubble. A ring of fire-cracked stones sits on the gritty floor.

3200.name: Under The Bridge
3200.description:
The arch under the bridge is covered by seaweed about a foot above the
surface of the river. The water gently flows through an opening in the
lower part of the city wall. The roar of water fills your ears. The
depths are dark and unknowable.

east.description: Deep waters churn near On The River

west.description: To the west lies On The River.

3201.name: On The River
3201.description:
North of here you see the miserable buildings of Poor Alley. The river
flows west towards the bridge. The riverbanks are too steep to climb.
The roar of water fills your ears. The depths are dark and unknowable.

east.description: Deep waters churn near On The River

west.description: Deep waters churn near Under The Bridge

3202.name: On The River
3202.description:
North of here you see the dump. The river flows from east to west. The
riverbanks are too steep to climb. Spray mists the air around. The
water churns with dangerous currents.

east.description: Deep waters churn near On The River

west.description: Deep waters churn near On The River

3203.name: On The River
3203.description:
The levee is directly north of here. The river flows in an east west
direction. The roar of water fills your ears. Waves crash and foam
relentlessly.

north.description: The cobblestones lead to The Levee

east.description: Deep waters churn near On The River

west.description: Deep waters churn near On The River

3204.name: On The River
3204.description:
You see the warehouse on the northern riverbank. East of here you see
the city wall. The river flows west towards the levee. Spray mists the
air around. The depths are dark and unknowable.

east.description: Deep waters churn near On The River

west.description: Deep waters churn near On The River

south.description: To the south lies None.

3205.name: On The River
3205.description:
The river enters from a hole in the eastern city wall. The hole has been
blocked by several vertically positioned iron bars set into the wall.
Spray mists the air around. The water churns with dangerous
currents.

east.description: To the east lies On The River.

west.description: Deep waters churn near On The River

3206.name: On The River

east.description: To the east lies Under The Bridge.

west.description: To the west lies On The River.

3206.description:
Here the river slips through an opening low in the city wall and into a
long vaulted culvert of old brick. A narrow towpath ledge runs along one
side above the dark water. Grey daylight leaks in from the east, where
the arch under the bridge hangs with ragged seaweed. The walls sweat and
drip, and the ledge leads on west into the gloom.

3207.name: On The River

east.description: To the east lies On The River.

west.description: To the west lies On The River.

3207.description:
An iron grating set into the vault lets down thin bars of light, and
through it drift the muffled sounds of the city above: cartwheels, a
shout, a slammed shutter. Below it the brick ledge is slick with green
slime. The river runs smooth and quiet beside you, carrying a scum of
straw and leaves. The culvert continues east toward the bridge and west
into darkness.

3208.name: On The River

east.description: To the east lies On The River.

west.description: To the west lies On The River.

3208.description:
A small niche is cut into the wall above the towpath, holding a crude
stone figure of a river spirit, its lap crusted with old candle wax.
Opposite, a side drain spills a thin stream into the river with a
constant chuckle. The bricks here are older and darker, laid in a
herringbone pattern by some forgotten mason. The ledge runs east and
west along the water.

extra_descs.niche figure spirit shrine:
The figure is no taller than a forearm, rough-carved from river stone,
with robes scored like fish scales and a calm, blank face. Bent pins
have been pressed into the old wax in its lap, offerings for luck from
those who work the culvert.

3209.name: On The River

east.description: To the east lies On The River.

west.description: To the west lies On The River.

3209.description:
The vault drops lower here, so that a tall traveller must stoop along
the ledge. Pale roots have forced their way through the mortar overhead
and hang down like threads, dripping onto the water. The noises of the
city have faded behind, and only the river's soft rush fills the tunnel.
A breath of fresher air, smelling of reeds and mud, comes from the west.

203210.name: On The River

east.description: To the east lies On The River.

west.description: To the west lies The Meeting Of Rivers.

203210.description:
The culvert ends in a broad arch of mossy stone, its rusted grille long
since wrenched up and left hanging. Green daylight pours in from the
west, where the river runs out to meet another current among the reeds.
The towpath here is crumbling, and ferns sprout from every crack in the
walls. Back east the tunnel stretches away under the city, dark and
dripping.

203211.name: On The River

east.description: To the east lies On The River.

west.description: To the west lies On The River.

203211.description:
The river runs fast and brown here, just outside the walls of Garathorm,
and it shoulders your boat back toward the city at every stroke. West,
the water slides under the grey stone of the wall through a low arch
guarded by iron bars. The banks are low shelves of pale, sun-cracked
rock, scattered with dry thorn and drifts of grit blown in from the
waste beyond. Upstream, the river comes on out of the east between
bleached boulders.

203212.name: On The River

east.description: To the east lies On The River.

west.description: To the west lies On The River.

203212.description:
Your boat labours against a strong brown current that carries silt and
the odd twist of dead brush down toward the city. A sandbar humps out of
the water near one bank, crusted white where the sun has dried it.
Beyond the low rock shelves the land is dust and scrub as far as the eye
can follow, shimmering with heat. The river leads east toward far grey
heights, and west back toward the walls.

203213.name: On The River

east.description: To the east lies On The River.

west.description: To the west lies On The River.

203213.description:
A weathered post leans out of the shallows near the bank, the frayed
stub of an old ferry rope still knotted around its top. The current
boils around it and drags at your hull, brown with the silt of distant
country. A dry wash cuts down through the bank here, its mouth choked
with pale stones rolled smooth in some long-ago flood. Open water leads
east against the current, or west with it.

3214.name: On The River

east.description: To the east lies On The River.

west.description: To the west lies On The River.

3214.description:
Red and ochre cliffs begin to crowd the river here, their faces carved
by the wind into ribs and hollows. The water is quick and opaque, the
colour of strong tea, and it slaps at your boat with small hard waves.
Tufts of salt-grass cling to the foot of the rocks wherever the spray
can reach them. Ahead, east, the banks grow higher; behind you, west,
they open out toward the plain.

3215.name: On The River

east.description: To the east lies On The River.

west.description: To the west lies On The River.

3215.description:
High on the cliff face above the water, someone long ago carved the
figure of a robed traveller with one arm raised toward the mountain.
Wind and blown sand have softened it until the face is gone. Below it
the river runs deep and fast, folding over hidden rocks in smooth brown
humps that rock your boat. The channel continues east and west between
sun-bleached walls.

extra_descs.figure traveller carving cliff:
The figure is twice the height of a man, cut in shallow relief into the
cliff. Its raised arm points upstream toward the mountain, and beneath
its feet a row of worn marks may once have been letters.

3216.name: On The River

east.description: To the east lies On The River.

west.description: To the west lies On The River.

3216.description:
The mountain fills the sky ahead now, a great shoulder of bare rock that
throws its shadow across the river. The water runs colder here and
faster, and a dull roar carries down from somewhere upstream. Boulders
the size of houses lie tumbled along both banks, split by heat and
frost. Your boat can push on east toward the noise or drift back west
into the sunlight.

3217.name: On The River

east.description: To the east lies Entering The Mountain.

west.description: To the west lies On The River.

3217.description:
Here the river bursts from a black tunnel mouth in the mountainside, and
the water just ahead is white with rapids. Spray drifts back over your
boat, cold even under the hot sun, and the rocks around the opening are
slick and dark with it. The roar of the water echoes out of the dark
like something breathing. The tunnel leads east into the mountain's
heart; the open river runs west, away toward the distant city walls.

5001.name: Entering The Mountain
5001.description:
You encounter some rapids as you enter this tunnel cut out of the
mountains by the river. Waves crash and foam relentlessly. The depths
are dark and unknowable.

east.description: Deep waters churn near A Long Tunnel

west.description: To the west lies On The River.

5002.name: A Narrowing In The Tunnel
5002.description:
The tunnel stretches endlessly through solid rock, carved by ancient
hands or perhaps erosion from underground rivers. Limestone walls
glisten with moisture, and your footsteps echo into the darkness ahead.
The depths are dark and unknowable. Waves crash and foam relentlessly.

north.description: A steep trail ascends to The Cave-In

east.description: Deep waters churn near A Long Tunnel

west.description: Deep waters churn near A Long Tunnel

5003.name: Riding The Rapids

east.description: Deep waters churn near A Tunnel Intersection

south.description: A steep trail ascends to A Narrow Crawlway

west.description: Deep waters churn near A Long Tunnel

5003.description:
Your boat bucks and spins through a run of rapids that roar between
walls of black, wet rock, and spray soaks everything. In the darkness
the water is felt more than seen, heaving and dropping beneath the hull.
On the south wall a low crawlway opens just above the waterline, barely
wide enough for a body to squeeze through. The torrent races on east
toward a meeting of tunnels, and back west lies the narrowing passage.

5004.name: Deep Under The Mountain
5004.description:
Multiple tunnels converge at this intersection, each passage
disappearing into darkness. Strange symbols are carved into the
junction's walls, possibly markers left by whoever built these passages.
Spray mists the air around. The depths are dark and unknowable.

east.description: Deep waters churn near An Underground Lake

south.description: A steep trail ascends to A Large Cavern

west.description: Deep waters churn near A Long Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies The River Of Lost Souls.

5005.name: An Underground Lake
5005.description:
The void stretches on a jet-black underground lake fed by dripping water
and lime from above. The tunnel continues to the east and the river
leads back west. Leading upwards to the northwest is a roughly hewn
hallway. Spray mists the air around. Waves crash and foam relentlessly.

north.description: To the north lies The Damp Hallway.

east.description: To the east lies An Underground Lake.

south.description: A steep trail ascends to A Sloping Passage

west.description: Deep waters churn near A Tunnel Intersection

5006.name: A Dry Narrow Tunnel
5006.description:
The tunnel rises sharply to the east. Another narrow tunnel leads away
to the north. Bare rock dominates the landscape. The wind howls around
exposed peaks.

north.description: To the north lies An Underground Lake.

east.description: A steep trail ascends to A Wide Tunnel

5007.name: A Hot Tunnel
5007.description:
The tunnel continues east and west. To the east the tunnel dives down
into a bright light. A small passage way opens to the north. The path is
steep and treacherous. Bare rock dominates the landscape.

east.description: An open path leads to The Great Eastern Desert

west.description: A steep trail ascends to A Long Narrow Tunnel

5008.name: The Cave-In
5008.description:
The area opens at the edge of a large pile of rubble created from the
last rockslide. Snow clings to shadowed crevices. The air is thin and
cold at this altitude.

north.description: To the north lies At The Cave.

south.description: Deep waters churn near A Long Tunnel

down.description: You can easily slide down the rocks without getting hurt.

5009.name: At The Foot Of The Rubble
5009.description:
This is the bottom of a large pile of rubble. A tunnel branches off to
the north and east. The path is steep and treacherous. The air is thin
and cold at this altitude.

north.description: A steep trail ascends to A Cave Entrance

east.description: A steep trail ascends to A Narrow Bend

up.description: A steep trail ascends to The Cave-In

5010.name: Cave Entrance
5010.description:
The area opens in the middle of a large and beautiful cave. A path leads
deeper into the darkness. Bare rock dominates the landscape. The path is
steep and treacherous.

south.description: A steep trail ascends to At The Foot Of The Rubble

down.description: You look down into the cave.  Bones are strewn about everywhere.

5011.name: A Giant Cave
5011.description:
This cavern overwhelms you. The walls and ceiling seem miles away. Bones
of previous adventurers lie strewn on the cavern floor. There is a
passage that spirals downwards in the northeast corner of the cavern.
Bare rock dominates the landscape. The wind howls around exposed peaks.

up.description: A steep trail ascends to A Cave Entrance

down.description: To the down lies A Bend In The City Street.

5012.name: Narrow Bend
5012.description:
The tunnel bends sharply here, forcing you to navigate carefully around
jagged outcroppings. Water trickles down the curved wall, leaving
mineral deposits that sparkle in any available light. Bare rock
dominates the landscape. The air is thin and cold at this altitude.

south.description: A steep trail ascends to A Large Cave

west.description: A steep trail ascends to At The Foot Of The Rubble

5013.name: A Large Cave
5013.description:
This is a large cave. Many furs are spread out on the floor. The path is
steep and treacherous. Snow clings to shadowed crevices. The rocky
terrain is steep and unforgiving. Thin air makes breathing difficult.

north.description: A steep trail ascends to A Narrow Bend

east.description: A steep trail ascends to A Damp Hallway

west.description: To the west lies Outside Of An Old Cave.

5014.name: A Damp Hallway
5014.description:
The walls here are extremely damp, as well as the floor. The path is
steep and treacherous. Bare rock dominates the landscape. The rocky
terrain is steep and unforgiving. Thin air makes breathing difficult.

east.description: You hear drops of water.

west.description: A steep trail ascends to A Large Cave

5015.name: An Underground Pool
5015.description:
A natural underground pool fills this chamber, its surface perfectly
still and dark as obsidian. The water looks deep and ancient, fed by
underground springs that predate the desert above. The current tugs
gently at your limbs. Fish dart beneath the waves.

south.description: To the south lies The Damp Hallway.

west.description: A steep trail ascends to A Damp Hallway

5016.name: The Damp Hallway
5016.description:
The walls of the tunnel are extremely damp here. The tunnel leads
sharply upwards to the south as it starts to get narrow. Snow clings to
shadowed crevices. The air is thin and cold at this altitude.

north.description: To the north lies An Underground Pool.

south.description: To the south lies An Underground Lake.

east.description: To the east lies On The Dark River.

5017.name: Narrow Crawlway
5017.description:
This crawlway is just big enough for a human to crawl through or a
halfling to walk through. The path is steep and treacherous. Bare rock
dominates the landscape.

north.description: Deep waters churn near A Long Tunnel

east.description: A steep trail ascends to A Large Cavern

south.description: You smell the fragrant odor of fungus.

5018.name: A Wonderful Cavern
5018.description:
The entrance opens to a very large cavern. The rock formations would
amaze almost any dwarf. Bare rock dominates the landscape. The path is
steep and treacherous.

north.description: Deep waters churn near A Tunnel Intersection

west.description: A steep trail ascends to A Narrow Crawlway

5019.name: The Fungus Patch
5019.description:
As you walk through the fungus patch, you are shot at by many millions
of spores. You can hardly breathe. Snow clings to shadowed crevices. The
wind howls around exposed peaks.

north.description: A steep trail ascends to A Narrow Crawlway

east.description: The fragrant smell of fungus spores continues to the east.

5020.name: Fungus Patch
5020.description:
As you walk along the path, millions of spores are shot at you. It is
difficult to breathe. A section of the path feels hollow underfoot. The
path is steep and treacherous. The air is thin and cold at this
altitude.

south.description: A giant mushroom temple stands to the south.

west.description: The fragrant smell of spores continues to the west.

5021.name: The Fungus Temple
5021.description:
The passage opens standing inside of a giant mushroom. The inside is
decorated in the fashion of a temple. Bare rock dominates the landscape.
Snow clings to shadowed crevices.

north.description: A steep trail ascends to The Fungus Path

east.description: A steep trail ascends to A Sloping Passage

5022.name: A Sloping Passage
5022.description:
You follow a path sloping down from the fungus temple. Snow clings to
shadowed crevices. The wind howls around exposed peaks. The rocky
terrain is steep and unforgiving. Thin air makes breathing difficult.

north.description: A steep trail ascends to A Sloping Passage

down.description: To the down lies A Sloping Passage.

5023.name: A Sloping Passage
5023.description:
The area is a path that gently slopes up from the underground pool. Snow
clings to shadowed crevices. The air is thin and cold at this altitude.
The rocky terrain is steep and unforgiving. Thin air makes breathing
difficult.

north.description: You hear sounds of trickling water.

south.description: A steep trail ascends to A Sloping Passage

up.description: To the up lies A Sloping Passage.

5063.name: The Wind-Swept Ledge
5063.description:
Being very careful not to lose your balance, you look around and find
that this canyon is about a half a kilometer deep. To the west is a dark
cave leading under the desert sands and above a rope bridge spans
the gap. The path is steep and treacherous. The air is thin and cold at
this altitude.

west.description: A steep trail ascends to The Cave Mouth

up.description: The desert sands blow down in your face.

5064.name: The Cavemouth
5064.description:
The air in here is MUCH cooler than outside. From the west you hear
strange sounds, but can see nothing. The cave slopes down into the
darkness. The air is thin and cold at this altitude. Snow clings to
shadowed crevices.

east.description: Outside is lighter and very windy.

west.description: A steep trail ascends to The Mysterious Lair

5065.name: The Mysterious Lair
5065.description:
You have stumbled upon the home of something. From the treasure
haphazardly strewn about and the rotting carcasses, you would guess that
this is a dragon's lair. As to what type, you can't really say. The cave
narrows out into a tunnel to the west. To the north, a treacherous
mountain path climbs toward distant peaks wreathed in smoke. The path is
steep and treacherous. The wind howls around exposed peaks.

east.description: A steep trail ascends to The Cave Mouth

west.description: A steep trail ascends to A Wide Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies The Mountain Pass.

5066.name: A Wide Tunnel
5066.description:
This tunnel seems to go on forever into the darkness. You carefully feel
your way along the walls. The wind howls around exposed peaks. The path
is steep and treacherous.

east.description: A steep trail ascends to The Mysterious Lair

west.description: A steep trail ascends to A Narrower Tunnel

5067.name: A Narrower Tunnel
5067.description:
The tunnel becomes very narrow and you fight to squeeze your way
through. The floor seems to level off a little. The path is steep and
treacherous. The wind howls around exposed peaks.

east.description: A steep trail ascends to A Wide Tunnel

south.description: A steep trail ascends to A Narrow Crack

5068.name: A Narrow Crack
5068.description:
This part of the tunnel is the hardest to move through as the walls move
in to meet you. The wind howls around exposed peaks. The air is thin and
cold at this altitude.

north.description: A steep trail ascends to A Narrower Tunnel

west.description: A steep trail ascends to A Small Cavern

5069.name: The Bat Cave
5069.description:
It is dark and damp and bats hang from the ceiling. A narrow crack is in
the east wall. The floor now slopes upwards. The path is steep and
treacherous. Bare rock dominates the landscape.

north.description: To the north lies A Small Shaft.

east.description: A steep trail ascends to A Narrow Crack

5070.name: A Small Shaft
5070.description:
From within this shaft Visible is a narrow hole in the roof just large
enough for one person. Back east is the cavern. The air is thin and cold
at this altitude. Snow clings to shadowed crevices.

south.description: To the south lies The Bat Cave.

up.description: A steep trail ascends to At The Foot Of The Rubble

205072.name: An Underground Lake

east.description: To the east lies On An Underground River.

south.description: To the south lies A Dry Narrow Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies An Underground Lake.

205072.description:
Your boat drifts on black, still water beneath a low ceiling of stone
hung with pale fingers of dripping lime. Each drop rings on the surface,
and the sound runs away into the dark. To the south a narrow tunnel
opens above a shelf of dry rock at the water's edge. The lake stretches
back west into blackness, while a slow current begins to tug the boat
east, where the water narrows into a river.

205073.name: On An Underground River

east.description: To the east lies On An Underground River.

west.description: To the west lies An Underground Lake.

205073.description:
The lake narrows into a river that slides through a tunnel of wet,
glittering rock, and the current takes your boat in its grip. The walls
pass close enough to touch, banded white and rust where minerals have
bled from the stone. The darkness is complete beyond whatever light you
carry, and the air smells of cold iron. The water hurries east; west, it
widens back into the lake.

205074.name: On An Underground River

east.description: To the east lies In A Waterfall.

west.description: To the west lies On An Underground River.

205074.description:
A roar grows ahead, deep enough to feel through the planks of your boat,
and the current quickens into a smooth, sliding rush. A grey smear of
daylight shows far down the tunnel to the east, hazed by rising mist.
The ceiling drips steadily, and pale threads of root hang through cracks
in the stone. Turning back west against the current takes hard work at
the oars.

5075.name: In A Waterfall

west.description: To the west lies On An Underground River.

down.description: To the down lies Falling In A Waterfall.

5075.description:
The river shoots out of the mountain into blinding daylight and pours
over a lip of smooth stone, and your boat teeters at the very brink.
Below, the water falls away in a white column, roaring into a gorge of
sun-bleached rock. Spray hangs in the air and throws a broken rainbow
across the cliffs. The only ways are the long drop down or a desperate
pull back west into the tunnel.

5076.name: Falling In A Waterfall

down.description: To the down lies In A River Gorge.

5076.description:
You are falling with the water, tumbling through a roaring white chaos
of spray and noise. The cliff streams past in a blur of wet stone and
clinging green moss. Somewhere far beneath, the pool at the foot of the
falls churns and waits. There is nothing to do but hold on to whatever
is left of your boat and go down with the river.

5077.name: In A River Gorge

east.description: To the east lies In A River Gorge.

5077.description:
The falls thunder into a deep green pool at the head of a narrow gorge,
and your boat spins in the churning water at their foot. Sheer walls of
pale, sun-bleached rock rise on both sides, far too smooth to climb, and
the waterfall itself cannot be fought. Only a strip of hot blue sky
shows overhead. The current gathers itself and runs east down the gorge.

5078.name: In A River Gorge

east.description: To the east lies In A River Gorge.

west.description: To the west lies In A River Gorge.

5078.description:
Fast brown water races between the walls of the gorge, slapping against
ledges and spinning your boat through narrow chutes. The cliffs are
striped in buff and rust, scoured smooth to the height of a tall man by
old floods, and dry tufts of grass cling to cracks above the flood line.
Hot sunlight strikes the water only at midday, when the shadows shrink
to nothing. The thunder of the falls echoes from the west, and the river
hurries on east.

5079.name: In A River Gorge

east.description: To the east lies On A High Banked River.

west.description: To the west lies In A River Gorge.

5079.description:
The gorge begins to widen here, and its walls step back in broken
terraces of bleached stone. A shingle bar splits the current, its
pebbles baked white by the sun, and your boat scrapes over its tail amid
chattering brown ripples. Driftwood lies jammed high in a crevice, left
there by some forgotten flood. Ahead, east, the river runs out between
high banks; behind, west, the gorge narrows toward the falls.

5080.name: On A High Banked River

east.description: To the east lies On A High Banked River.

west.description: To the west lies In A River Gorge.

5080.description:
Earthen banks rise steeply on either side, higher than a mounted rider,
their faces riddled with burrows and the dangling roots of the scrub
that grows along the top. The river is still deep and quick, dark brown
with silt, and it bumps your boat along with steady force. Above the
banks, a hot dry wind lifts the dust into the air. The water runs on
east, and back west into the gorge.

5081.name: On A High Banked River

east.description: To the east lies On A Wide River.

west.description: To the west lies On A High Banked River.

5081.description:
The current eases here, and the water clears enough to show a bed of
rounded stones beneath your boat. The banks are still high and steep,
cut in layers of red clay and pale sand like the pages of a book.
Nesting holes pock the upper layers, and grass fringes the rim against a
wide sky. Downstream, east, the river spreads wider; upstream, west, it
quickens toward the gorge.

5082.name: On A Wide River

east.description: To the east lies On A Wide River.

west.description: To the west lies On A High Banked River.

5082.description:
The banks fall away and the river spreads wide and shallow across a bed
of sand and pebbles. Reeds stand in green ranks along both edges,
rustling in the warm wind, and the water is clear enough to show every
ripple's shadow on the bottom. Your boat glides easily now. The open
river continues east, while west the banks climb high again.

5083.name: On A Wide River

east.description: To the east lies On A Wide River.

west.description: To the west lies On A Wide River.

5083.description:
Broad and slow, the river meanders across open country, its surface
wrinkled by the breeze into a thousand glints of light. Low islands of
reed and mud dot the water, and a line of willows marks the far bank.
The air carries the first faint tang of salt from somewhere ahead. Your
boat can follow the current east or work back west.

5084.name: On A Wide River

east.description: To the east lies On A Wide River.

west.description: To the west lies On A Wide River.

5084.description:
The river is very wide here, and its water has turned faintly brackish,
tasting of salt on the spray. Clumps of sea-pink and samphire grow on
the mudbanks, and the wind blows in cool and damp from the open sea that
lies somewhere beyond the flats. Old mooring stakes stand crooked in the
shallows. The current carries your boat on east toward the Sea of
Storms, or you can pull back west.

8903.name: The Split Of The River

north.description: To the north lies The Northern Branch Of The River.

south.description: To the south lies The Slow Part Of The River.

8903.description:
A long spit of gravel and reed divides the water here, and your boat
rides the seam where two currents part. The northern arm runs quick and
bright between willows, while the southern arm spreads out slow and dark
under a skin of duckweed. Tracks of many small feet pattern the mud at
the tip of the spit. The banks beyond are rough pasture, open to the
wind.

8904.name: The Northern Branch Of The River

east.description: To the east lies The Northern Branch Of The River.

south.description: To the south lies The Split Of The River.

8904.description:
Here the branch swings in a long curve, and the current presses your
boat toward a steep bank of crumbling earth. A squat marker stone stands
at the water's edge, carved with the tower sigil of Garathorm and green
with lichen. Willows trail their leaves in the water, and the open
meadows beyond them stir in the wind. The river turns south toward the
place where it splits, and runs east toward the old mill.

extra_descs.marker stone sigil:
A knee-high block of grey stone, its top worn round by weather. The
carving shows a walled tower above three wavy lines, the old sign that
these waters belong to the city of Garathorm.

8905.name: The Northern Branch Of The River

east.description: To the east lies The Northern Branch Of The River.

west.description: To the west lies The Northern Branch Of The River.

8905.description:
On one bank stand the stone footings of an old water mill, its wheel
long gone and its sluice choked with drifted branches. The branch runs
clear and brisk past the ruin, rippling over a shallow sill of flat
stones that scrape gently under your boat. Meadowsweet and nettles crowd
the bank above. The water leads on west, and back east toward the
meeting of the rivers.

8906.name: The Northern Branch Of The River

east.description: To the east lies The Meeting Of Rivers.

west.description: To the west lies The Northern Branch Of The River.

8906.description:
The water of this branch runs clear and cold over a bed of gravel, and
your boat slips along with only a whisper against the hull. Alders lean
out from the banks, trailing their lower twigs in the current. A fallen
trunk lies half-sunk along one edge, furred with green moss. The branch
winds on west, and east it joins the other river.

8907.name: The Meeting Of Rivers

east.description: To the east lies On The River.

west.description: To the west lies The Northern Branch Of The River.

8907.description:
Two currents meet here and swirl together around your boat, one cool and
clear, the other carrying the darker water that runs out of the culvert
to the east. Eddies spin lazily along the seam between them. Reeds and
yellow flag iris crowd both banks, and beyond them rough meadow rolls
away under a wide sky. The Northern Branch Of The River opens to the
west.

8908.name: The Slow Part Of The River

north.description: To the north lies The Split Of The River.

south.description: To the south lies In The Riverbend.

8908.description:
The river all but stops here, lying deep and glassy between banks of
soft black mud. Water lilies spread their pads across the surface, and
your boat pushes through them with a slow, wet rustle. The air is warm
and still, thick with the smell of mint and rotting leaves. Only a faint
drift carries you south toward the bend, while north the water quickens
toward the split.

8909.name: In The Riverbend

north.description: To the north lies The Slow Part Of The River.

west.description: To the west lies In The Riverbend.

8909.description:
The river turns sharply here, carving a tall bank of raw earth on the
outside of the bend where roots hang bare above the water. On the inner
side a little beach of pale sand slopes gently into the shallows. The
current swings your boat around in a slow arc. Upstream lies the slow
water to the north, and the bend carries on west.

8910.name: In The Riverbend

north.description: To the north lies In The Riverbend.

east.description: To the east lies In The Riverbend.

8910.description:
An ancient crack willow grows half in the river here, its split trunk
leaning so far out that its crown nearly touches the far bank. Water
gurgles through the hollow at its base. The current eddies in a broad
brown pool where leaves turn in slow circles around your boat. The river
winds away north, and back east around the bend.

8911.name: In The Riverbend

south.description: To the south lies In The Riverbend.

west.description: To the west lies On The River.

8911.description:
A rickety fishing platform of grey planks juts from the bank on a few
leaning posts, built by some patient soul and long since abandoned. The
water beneath your boat is deep and slow, with long weeds streaming in
the current like green hair. Grassy slopes rise on both sides toward a
line of distant trees. The river bends away west, and south it curls
back around the old willow.

8912.name: On The River

east.description: To the east lies In The Riverbend.

west.description: To the west lies In The Riverbend.

8912.description:
This is a straight, easy reach where the river runs smooth between open
meadows. A broken fence of split rails comes down to the water on one
side, and the bank there is churned into hoof-pocked mud where cattle
come to drink. The sky is wide and full of moving cloud. Your boat
drifts west with the current or can be paddled back east.

8913.name: In The Riverbend

north.description: To the north lies On The River.

east.description: To the east lies On The River.

8913.description:
The river loops around a shoulder of higher ground crowned with a stand
of beeches, and their roots form a gnarled stair down to the water.
Clear water runs over stones of every colour, and your boat grinds
gently on a gravel bar before sliding free. The meadows are left behind
here, and the trees begin to close in. The bend leads north under the
beeches, and east back to the open reach.

8914.name: On The River

south.description: To the south lies In The Riverbend.

west.description: To the west lies On The River.

8914.description:
Woods press close on both banks now, oak and ash with a tangled
understorey of hazel, and the light on the water turns green and
dappled. A faint, steady rumble drifts on the air from somewhere
downstream. The current has quickened, and your boat begins to move with
purpose. The river runs on west toward the sound, and back south around
the beech-crowned bend.

8915.name: On The River

east.description: To the east lies On The River.

west.description: To the west lies At The Waterfall.

8915.description:
The rumble has become a roar, and a fine mist drifts back upstream to
bead on your clothes and the gunwales of your boat. The river runs fast
and smooth toward a ragged line where the water seems simply to end, and
beyond it hangs a haze of white spray above treetops far below. Ferns
and moss grow thick on the wet rocks of the banks. The edge lies just
west; the calmer reach lies back east.

8916.name: At The Waterfall

east.description: To the east lies On The River.

down.description: To the down lies The Lake.

8916.description:
The river slides over a broad lip of mossy stone and drops in a
thundering white curtain to a lake far below. Your boat hangs at the
very edge, held by an eddy behind a jutting rock. To one side the water
has worn a smooth, steep chute through the stone, the one way down a
boat might survive. Upstream, the river runs back east under the trees.

8917.name: The Lake

north.description: To the north lies The Lake.

east.description: To the east lies Behind The Waterfall.

south.description: To the south lies The Lake.

west.description: To the west lies The Lake.

8917.description:
The waterfall crashes into the lake right beside your boat, and the
water here heaves and boils in a never-ending churn of foam. Spray
drenches everything and fills the air with a constant roar. Through the
curtain of falling water to the east, a dark opening shows in the cliff
behind. The lake spreads out calmer to the north, south and west, ringed
by tall pines.

8918.name: Behind The Waterfall

west.description: To the west lies The Lake.

8918.description:
Behind the falling water lies a hollow in the cliff, a low cave whose
walls glisten with spray and are furred with bright green moss. The
light here is strange and shifting, filtered through the roaring white
curtain that hides the opening. The floor is a ledge of smooth, wet
stone that slopes back into darkness and ends against solid rock. The
only way out is west, through the water, back to the lake.

8919.name: The Lake

north.description: To the north lies The Lake.

west.description: To the west lies The Lake.

8919.description:
Boulders lie scattered through the shallows here, worn round by the
endless pounding of the falls nearby. Mist drifts across the water in
slow veils, and when the sun breaks through it a faint rainbow arches
over the lake. Your boat bumps gently against a mossy stone. The
churning water beneath the falls lies north, and sandy shallows lie
west.

8920.name: The Lake

north.description: To the north lies The Lake.

east.description: To the east lies The Lake.

8920.description:
A shelving beach of grey sand edges the lake here, strewn with bleached
driftwood and marked by the tracks of beasts come down to drink. The
water is shallow and warm, and reeds rise in thick clumps around your
boat. A sunken log lies just beneath the surface, slick with green weed.
Deeper water lies north and east.

8921.name: The Lake

north.description: To the north lies The Lake.

east.description: To the east lies The Lake.

south.description: To the south lies The Lake.

west.description: To the west lies The Dark River.

8921.description:
Here the lake begins to drain away, its water drawn slowly toward a gap
in the trees where a river leaves it, dark beneath overhanging boughs.
Your boat turns idly in the gentle pull. Behind, the falls throw up a
white haze above the water. The open lake lies north, east and south,
and the Dark River slides away west into the forest's shadow.

8922.name: The Lake

east.description: To the east lies The Lake.

south.description: To the south lies The Lake.

8922.description:
A tall outcrop of grey rock rises straight out of the water here, its
ledges tufted with heather and stunted birch. The lake lies dark and
still at its foot, so deep that the bottom is lost to sight beneath your
boat. Pines crowd the far shore, their reflections unbroken on the calm
surface. The water leads east toward the lilies and south toward the
lake's outflow.

8923.name: The Lake

south.description: To the south lies The Lake.

west.description: To the west lies The Lake.

8923.description:
This quiet reach of the lake lies in the shelter of a mossy cliff, out
of the worst of the spray. Water lilies float in a broad green raft,
their white blossoms closed tight in the shade. The water is clear and
deep enough that your boat seems to hang above the pale stones on the
bottom. The thunder of the falls comes from the south, and open water
stretches west.

8924.name: The Dark River

east.description: To the east lies The Lake.

west.description: To the west lies The Dark River.

8924.description:
The river leaves the lake and slips beneath a roof of black-barked
trees, and at once the light fails and the air turns cool. The water is
stained as dark as strong ale by fallen leaves, and your boat seems to
float on nothing at all. Long grey beards of lichen hang from the
branches overhead. Behind you, east, the lake glimmers in the daylight;
ahead, west, the river winds into the gloom.

8925.name: The Dark River

east.description: To the east lies The Dark River.

west.description: To the west lies Split Of The Dark River.

8925.description:
Huge, twisted roots reach out of the banks and down into the black water
like the fingers of drowned giants. The canopy is so thick that only a
thin crack of grey sky shows above the river's course. The silence is
heavy, broken only by the drip of water from the leaves and the soft
creak of your boat. The river winds on west, and back east toward the
lake.

8926.name: Split Of The Dark River

north.description: To the north lies The Dark River.

east.description: To the east lies The Dark River.

south.description: To the south lies In The Bend Of The River.

8926.description:
Here the Dark River divides around a low, wooded island, one arm curving
away north and the other south. The current hesitates at the parting,
and your boat drifts in a slow circle on the black water. Through the
trees of the island the mossy roof of a cabin can just be seen. The way
back east leads toward the lake.

8927.name: In The Bend Of The River

north.description: To the north lies Split Of The Dark River.

south.description: To the south lies In The Undergrowth.

west.description: To the west lies The Dark River.

8927.description:
A muddy landing opens on the bank here, where the undergrowth comes
right down to the water in a wall of bramble, elder and nettle. A path
of sorts pushes south into the thicket, little more than a gap in the
leaves. The river bends here, running north to where it splits around
the island and west along the island's lower shore. Your boat bumps
against a half-sunk log.

8928.name: In The Undergrowth

north.description: To the north lies In The Bend Of The River.

8928.description:
The thicket closes in on every side, a dense green maze of bramble,
elder and waist-high nettles that snag at clothes and skin. Overhead the
dark trees of the river forest blot out all but a few coins of light. A
trampled hollow in the middle shows where some large beast has bedded
down, and its musky smell lingers. The only way out is the narrow gap
leading north to the landing.

8929.name: The Dark River

east.description: To the east lies In The Bend Of The River.

west.description: To the west lies In The River Bend.

8929.description:
The water here runs between steep banks of exposed roots and stones, and
the current picks up a little, chuckling over a shallow sill. Your boat
scrapes over the sill and slides on. A single silver birch stands out
pale against the dark trees, its bark scored with old carved initials.
The river's course leads east toward a muddy landing and west around the
island's lower bend.

8930.name: In The River Bend

north.description: To the north lies The Dark River.

east.description: To the east lies The Dark River.

8930.description:
The river turns sharply around the island's lower end, where a bar of
black silt has built up on the inside of the bend. Sticks and dead
leaves have piled against it into a tangled dam, and the water spills
over in a soft rush that rocks your boat. The trees lean so close that
their branches knit together overhead. The river bends away north and
east.

8931.name: The Dark River

north.description: To the north lies The Dark River.

south.description: To the south lies In The River Bend.

8931.description:
Tall ferns lean out over the water here, and the banks are hidden
beneath them so that the river seems to flow through a green tunnel. The
water is very still, and every drip from the leaves sends rings
spreading across the surface around your boat. A pale stone carved with
a spiral sits half-buried in the bank among the ferns. The river runs
north and south.

extra_descs.pale stone spiral:
The stone is smooth and pale, about the size of a crouching sheep, and
the spiral cut into it winds inward seven times. Moss fills the groove,
but the line is still sharp, as if whoever cut it meant it to last.

8932.name: The Dark River

north.description: To the north lies In The River Bend.

south.description: To the south lies The Dark River.

west.description: To the west lies The Dark River.

8932.description:
A side channel breaks away west through a gap in the trees here, drawing
off part of the black water with a soft, sucking gurgle. The main stream
runs on north and south along the island's far side. Across the water,
the island's trees stand close and dark, and the smell of old woodsmoke
drifts from among them. Your boat rocks in the cross-currents where the
waters divide.

8933.name: In The River Bend

east.description: To the east lies The Dark River.

south.description: To the south lies The Dark River.

8933.description:
The river doubles back on itself here around the far side of the island,
and your boat turns slowly in a deep, dark pool at the bend. An old
rowing boat lies rotting on the bank, its planks sprung and green with
moss, half swallowed by ferns. Somewhere overhead the wind moves in the
treetops, though hardly a breath reaches the water. The bend leads east
and south.

8934.name: The Dark River

east.description: To the east lies In The River Bend.

west.description: To the west lies In The River Bend.

8934.description:
This stretch of the river is narrow and deep, walled in by banks of
black mud where the roots of yew trees knot together. Clusters of pale
toadstools grow along a rotting log at the water's edge, glowing faintly
in the gloom. The current is sluggish, and your boat moves only as fast
as the oars can push it. The river runs east toward the drowned oak and
west into a further bend.

8935.name: In The River Bend

south.description: To the south lies The Dark River.

west.description: To the west lies The Dark River.

8935.description:
The river bends hard around the head of the island, and the current
shoves your boat toward a bank of tangled bramble and fallen trees. A
great drowned oak lies across half the channel, its bare limbs rising
from the water like the ribs of a wreck. The forest is very dark here
and smells of wet earth and fungus. The channel leads west past the
fallen giant, and south along the island's shore.

8936.name: The Dark River

north.description: To the north lies In The River Bend.

south.description: To the south lies Split Of The Dark River.

west.description: To the west lies The Small Island.

8936.description:
The island's shore lies close at hand to the west, where a patch of
trampled grass makes a landing among the roots. A narrow trail runs from
it toward a small cabin half hidden in the trees. An old iron ring is
driven into a stump at the water's edge, just right for mooring your
boat. The river runs dark and slow along the shore, curving north around
the island and south toward the place where it splits.

8937.name: The Small Island

east.description: To the east lies The Dark River.

south.description: To the south lies Inside The Cabin.

8937.description:
The island is a small rise of rough grass and wildflowers, ringed by
dark trees whose roots drink from the river on every side. A trail worn
through the grass runs from the landing on the east shore to a low log
cabin standing to the south. Overhead the canopy opens just enough to
show a patch of sky. An old chopping block, scarred by countless blows,
stands in the grass.

8938.name: Inside The Cabin

north.description: To the north lies The Small Island.

8938.description:
The cabin is a single cramped room of rough-hewn logs, chinked with moss
and clay, and it smells of damp ashes and old pipe smoke. A fieldstone
hearth fills one wall, its chimney stained black, and a plank bed and a
heavy table built from split logs take up most of the floor. Light falls
in through a small window of scraped horn. The doorway leads north, back
out onto the island.

extra_descs.hearth lintel tally marks:
Someone has scratched rows of tally marks into the lintel stone above
the hearth, dozens of them in neat groups of five. They look like the
count of days in a long and lonely stay.

8939.name: The Dark River

east.description: To the east lies The Dark River.

west.description: To the west lies In The River Bend.

8939.description:
The side channel runs narrow and quick between walls of dark holly,
carrying your boat away from the island at a steady pace. The water is
clearer here, and long ribbons of weed wave beneath the surface.
Somewhere ahead the sound of a louder, faster river can be heard through
the trees. The channel leads west, and back east toward the island.

8940.name: In The River Bend

east.description: To the east lies The Dark River.

south.description: To the south lies In The River Bend.

8940.description:
The channel turns sharply around a steep bank where a badger sett has
been dug deep among the roots of an old oak, its spoil heaps fresh and
pale. The water runs fast around the outside of the bend, and you have
to fend your boat off a fallen branch. The forest begins to thin a
little, letting grey light through. The channel curves south, and back
east toward the island.

8941.name: In The River Bend

north.description: To the north lies In The River Bend.

west.description: To the west lies The Dark River.

8941.description:
Here the channel bends once more, broadening as it goes, and swirls of
muddy brown from somewhere ahead begin to mingle with the dark water
around your boat. The banks are lower, fringed with sedge and purple
loosestrife. The roar of a big river is close now, beyond a screen of
alder. The water leads west toward it and north back along the channel.

8942.name: The Dark River

north.description: To the north lies On The Swift Flowing River.

east.description: To the east lies In The River Bend.

west.description: To the west lies On The Swift Flowing River.

8942.description:
The Dark River pours its black water into a broad, swift river here, and
the two run side by side for a while, dark and brown, before the
stronger current swallows the weaker. Your boat bucks in the tumbling
seam between them. High banks rise beyond, crowned with the trees of
Haon-Dor. The swift river can be joined to the north or to the west, and
the quieter channel runs back east.

5000.name: dervish
5000.long_desc: A raggity dervish walks on aimlessly.
5000.description: Dressed in loose fitting rags, this man looks like he could use some rest.

5001.name: dervish
5001.long_desc: A large dervish watches for signs of trouble.
5001.description:
Dressed in loose fitting rags, this man looks like he could use LOTS of
rest.

5002.name: snake
5002.long_desc: A brightly colored snake slithers along the sands.
5002.description:
This relatively harmless snake has bright alternating bands of red, yellow
and black.

5003.name: scorpion
5003.long_desc: A small, red scorpion scuttles away at your approach.
5003.description: The little tail is mighty dangerous for such a small creature.

5004.name: worm
5004.long_desc: A giant, purple sand worm thrusts up out of the sand and attacks!
5004.description: He's big, mean, and purple.  Watch out!

5005.name: dragon
5005.long_desc: A very large brass dragon steps out of the darkness and says 'Hello.'
5005.description: Then adds to it, 'Prepare to die, have a nice day!'

5006.name: nomad
5006.long_desc: The nomad leader sits silently in prayer.
5006.description:
He is clad in silk robes lined with gold thread. At his side is a large,
engraved cutlass.  He has an especially haughty air about him.

5007.name: nomad
5007.long_desc: The nomad commander stands here staring at you suspiciously.
5007.description:
This is the nomad leader's second in command.  His clothes are richly woven
of silk and gold thread.  A nasty cutlass hangs at his side.

5008.name: nomad
5008.long_desc: A proud nomad warrior stands here.
5008.description: This warrior is dressed in typical nomad clothing and looks quite mean.

5009.name: slave
5009.long_desc: A young slave sits here staring at you with pleading eyes.
5009.description: She looks quite thin and weak.

5010.name: dracolich
5010.long_desc: A pile of bones rises up to form a skeletal dracolich.
5010.description:
The dracolich is now only bone with pieces of flesh hanging from it.
Obviously it no longer fears death.

5011.name: drider
5011.long_desc: The drider looks at you viciously while it draws its sword.
5011.description: This half-spider, half-drow creature is a formidable opponent.

5012.name: duergar
5012.long_desc: A duergar is here mining precious stones with his pick.
5012.description:
The duergar could probably crush your head as easily as he does those
rocks.

5013.name: myconoid
5013.description:
The myconoid looks something like a giant mushroom (and probably has the
same effect).

5014.name: myconoid
5014.long_desc: A rather large myconoid stands here chanting in a strange tongue.
5014.description: The shaman shoots spores into the air.

5015.name: dustdigger
5015.long_desc: A small oasis invites you to dive in.
5015.description:
Looking a little closer at this oasis, you begin to wonder why
it seems to be moving about...

5017.name: camel
5017.long_desc: A very dangerous creature, a camel, snorts at you.
5017.description:
It is advisable not to mess with this creature.  After all, you
have heard many a horror story about experiences with camels.
Bad experiences.

5098.name: trembling torchbearer
5098.long_desc: A trembling torchbearer crouches here, his torch barely flickering.
5098.description: He was hired to light the way for an expedition that never returned. Now he sits alone in the dark, too afraid to go forward, too lost to go back.

talk_responses.hello: The torchbearer's voice cracks. 'They went deeper. All of them. Said there was treasure past the underground lake. None came back. I can still hear the echoes of their screams sometimes... or maybe that's just the wind.'
talk_responses.treasure: He laughs bitterly. 'Gold means nothing when you're dead. But if you must know — the richest veins are near the lake. That's where the worst things live, too.'
talk_responses.default: The torchbearer clutches his guttering torch. 'Please... do you know the way out?'

605000.name: crab river mud-brown
605000.long_desc: A mud-brown river crab clings to a stone in the current, claws raised.
605000.description:
The crab is as broad as a buckler, its shell the colour of river silt
and crusted with tiny pale barnacles. One claw is much larger than the
other and bears a jagged edge that could snap a finger. Its eyes swivel
on short stalks, following every movement.

605001.name: frog giant river
605001.long_desc: A giant river frog squats half-submerged among the weeds, its throat pulsing.
605001.description:
The frog is the size of a large dog, mottled green and black, with cold
golden eyes set high on its flat head. Its wide mouth could swallow a
goose whole, and river folk say it will gulp down anything that glints.
A rank smell of pond mud clings to its slick skin.

605002.name: heron grey bird
605002.long_desc: A grey heron stands motionless in the shallows, watching the water.
605002.description:
Tall and gaunt, the heron stands on legs as thin as reeds, its grey
plumage edged with black and a long dark plume trailing from its crown.
Its dagger of a beak is poised above the water, and its yellow eye
misses nothing. When it strikes, it strikes faster than thought.

605003.name: kobold scavenger
605003.long_desc: A kobold scavenger crouches over a heap of salvage, sorting it with quick claws.
605003.description:
The kobold is a scrawny, dog-faced little creature no taller than a
child, with rust-red scales, a ratlike tail and small horns curling back
from its brow. It is hung about with a jangling collection of stolen
buckles, cord and bits of broken lamps. Its yellow eyes dart greedily to
anything you carry.

5000.name: pick
5000.room_desc: A small mining pick made of what appears to be silver lies on the ground.

5002.name: halberd
5002.room_desc: A mighty halberd lies against the wall.

5003.name: amulet
5003.room_desc: A mushroom-shaped amulet lies on the ground.

5005.name: bone
5005.room_desc: A large leg bone rests on the ground.

5006.name: cactus
5006.room_desc: A small cactus cup lies on the ground.

5007.name: basket
5007.room_desc: A small wicker basket sits on the ground.

5009.name: basket
5009.room_desc: A small wicker basket sits on the ground.

5010.name: basket
5010.room_desc: A small wicker basket sits on the ground.

5011.name: rope
5011.room_desc: A long coil of rope lies on the ground.

5012.name: stakes
5012.room_desc: A small bundle of stakes lies here.

5013.name: map
5013.room_desc: An old, tattered, and much faded map lies here.

5014.name: turban
5014.room_desc: A thick padded turban lies here.

5015.name: coins
5015.room_desc: A great, gleaming pile of treasure lies at your feet.

5016.name: sabre
5016.room_desc: A long, curved sabre stands upright in the ground.

5017.name: scimitar
5017.room_desc: A curved scimitar lies at your feet.

5018.name: cutlass
5018.room_desc: A long, pointed cutlass lies here.

5021.name: bow
5021.room_desc: A powerful golden bow lies here.

5022.name: scroll
5022.room_desc: An encrypted scroll lies at your feet.

5023.name: chest
5023.room_desc: An iron bound chest with a shiny lock sits here.

5024.name: key
5024.room_desc: A shiny golden key lies here.

5025.name: bracelet
5025.room_desc: A tarnished copper bracelet lies at your feet.

5026.name: ruby
5026.room_desc: A large ruby lies on the ground, collecting dust.

5027.name: diamond
5027.room_desc: A glittering diamond lies at your feet.

5028.name: sapphire
5028.room_desc: A brilliant sapphire lies here, twinkling happily.

5029.name: lapis
5029.room_desc: A deep blue lapis lazuli gem lies here.

5030.name: jewel
5030.room_desc: The Tiger Jewel lies here blazing.

5031.name: jewel
5031.room_desc: The red-eyed jewel glares at you greedily.

5032.name: emerald
5032.room_desc: A fiery green emerald sits here.

5050.name: a sand-worn tablet
5050.room_desc: A sand-worn tablet rests against the wall.
5050.description: Faded carvings depict a sun disk and a winding road.
5050.lore_text: "We followed the star that burned at noon and found the well that never dried."

5051.name: a nomad's letter
5051.room_desc: A bundle of letters lies here.
5051.description: The paper is brittle but still legible.
5051.lore_text: "The dunes shift each night. Trust the rocks, not the stars."

5052.name: a sun-baked reliquary chest
5052.room_desc: A sun-baked chest is half-buried here.
5052.description: The lid is etched with a blazing sun.

5053.name: an oasis copper key
5053.room_desc: A copper key glints at the edge of the pool.
5053.description: The key smells faintly of fresh water.

5054.name: a scorpionglass amulet
5054.room_desc: A dark amulet glints in the shade.
5054.description: A piece of black glass carved into a scorpion.

5063.name: scarf of the wastes
5063.room_desc: A scarf of the wastes lies here.

705000.name: lantern spelunker brass hooded
705000.room_desc: A dented brass lantern with a hinged hood lies here on its side.
705000.description: A squat brass lantern with a hinged iron hood that can be closed to a slit, the kind cave-delvers hang from their belts. Its glass is scratched and its handle is wrapped in greasy cord, but the wick is good and the oil well is deep.

705001.name: fungus caps glowing mushroom
705001.short_desc: a handful of glowing fungus caps
705001.room_desc: A handful of pale fungus caps glows softly on the ground.
705001.description: These small, pale mushroom caps give off a soft blue-green glow, bright enough to read by in a dark place. They smell of earth and wet stone, and those who have eaten them say they taste faintly of hazelnuts.

705002.name: charm stone river smooth cord
705002.room_desc: A smooth grey stone threaded on a leather cord lies here.
705002.description: A flat, egg-shaped pebble polished by the river until it feels like silk, bored through and threaded on a thong of plaited leather. A tiny wave has been scratched into one face. River folk say such stones keep a clear head in deep water.

705003.name: feather heron grey plume
705003.room_desc: A long grey heron feather lies here, lifting slightly in the air.
705003.description: A flight feather as long as a forearm, soft grey shading to black at the tip. Fletchers and hatters in Garathorm pay well for an unbroken feather like this one.
